text:
mia (AE): Heads up @oliver — Peakline (EU financial) just escalated. POC on hold: 1) they need a temporary dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for a high-volume 48-72h stress run, 2) they insist on BYO-KMS with HSM attestation + SOC2 evidence before exec sign-off. also pushing on pricing: want us to clarify burst vs reserved pricing for sustained >1B tokens/day.
arnav (SE): From the call: their ingest will dump ~600M tokens/day then eval spikes to ~1.2B tokens/day during scoring. They also require all data/eval traffic to stay inside eu-west-1 and key rotation on their KMS.
sofia (Solutions Eng): We can map a plan: temporary Dedicated (reserved nodes) pinned to eu-west-1; BYO-KMS path supported (VPC/private endpoints). HSM attestation is not something we generate for customer HSMs 
docs — we can accept vendor attestation or customer-supplied cert.
sofia (Solutions Eng): Quick tech bullets we can share on the exec note:
- Private endpoints + VPC peering
- Dedicated capacity (reserved for window)
- BYO-KMS supported; key wrap and no-key-access config
- Logs and audit trail export (to their S3)
james (Security Eng): We will provide our SOC2 report and list of in-scope controls. For HSM attestation: need either (A) customer provides HSM vendor attestation/cert, or (B) customer authorizes a short security call for joint attestation where they show vendor docs. Also need the specific questionnaire entries they want answered.
nina (Prod Eng): Capacity note: sustaining >1B tokens/day is a big commit. Ops can provision an isolated pool but needs a PO + billing hold. ETA normal: ~72h after PO. Priority provisioning (exec-approved) maybe 24-36h. We'll cap bursts if pool hits thermal limits.
kate (Legal): For BYO-KMS we use our standard KMS addendum language: "Customer controls keys; Redwood does not persist access to plaintext." I can prepare the KMS addendum + NDA addendum for sharing deeper infra diagrams. Need customer legal contact and sign-off.
mia (AE): Customer already pushed two security pages; redacted snippet: "must provide HSM attestation, key rotation policy, and proof of crypto isolation." They expect an exec-level note for their board by EOD.
ops-bot: Provisioning request #PR-98123 created by arnav. Status: pending eng-infra approval.
oliver (VP Sales): OK. Prioritize. Mia, get PO or written budget commitment and customer legal contact. @nina @sofia, can you confirm we can run a quarantined Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for 72h and share estimated cost today? @james @kate, assemble a 1-page exec brief: what we can commit to now vs. what needs customer deliverables (HSM cert, signed addendum). I want this to the customer before their board call.
sofia (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the 1-pager. Technical: yes we can isolate Dedicated nodes for the window, but ops needs PO. Estimate: 8x A100 equiv nodes for their peak -> pricing below.
james (Security Eng): I'll list the security checklist and highlight gaps: HSM attestation (customer), KMS rotation proof (customer), SOC2 (we can provide). Requesting NDA addendum to share infra diagrams is reasonable.
kate (Legal): NDA addendum ready to draft. Will also draft KMS addendum. Need the customer's legal email.
mia (AE): Looping in customer legal on email thread now. Asking for PO and HSM vendor docs.
arnav (SE): Action items summarized:
- ops/prod: quota & pool provisioning (nina)
- security: SOC2 + HSM checklist (james)
- legal: KMS addendum + NDA addendum (kate)
- sales: Exec 1-pager + reserved throughput pricing (mia/oliver/sofia)
Please post ETAs here.
nina (Prod Eng): Ops ETA: pending PO -> standard 72h to provision and validate. If VP Sales approves priority, we can aim 24-36h.
oliver (VP Sales): I'll escalate for priority if we get PO today. Mia, push for PO or a 1-line budget commitment. If they need an immediate letter for the board I can sign an intent note contingent on addendum.
mia (AE): Got it. I'll push and update this thread. :thumbsup:
